newsitem.title: UK: BoE's George says MPC has no bias on rates.
newsitem.headline: BoE's George says MPC has no bias on rates.

text.p: Bank of England Governor Eddie George said on Wednesday Britain's new monetary policy committee carried no bias on interest rates one way or another because it had a symmetrical inflation remit.
"Why would the committee not be biased one way or the other? Basically, because its instruction is a totally symmetrical one," he told the House of Commons Treasury Select Committee.
George was pressed as to whether the Bank, in its eagerness to meet the inflation target, may not be too keen to put up interest rates to the detriment of the economy.

He said the government has set a target for underlying inflation of 2.5 percent, with penalties set for straying too far either way. Under the previous, Conservative government, the inflation remit was to keep at 2.5 percent or less.
